stemMarkdown: Two positive numbers add up to 50. What is the maximum possible value of their product?
solutionMarkdown: By AM-GM, for a fixed sum the product is largest when the numbers are equal. Each is $\dfrac{50}{2} = 25.0$, so the maximum product is $25.0 \times 25.0 = 625.0$.
altSolutionMarkdown: Equality in AM-GM always happens when the terms are equal — that is what makes it an optimisation tool.
